topology.reverse_pair: both directions share one exact duplex_group and identical full_duplex mode

resources.duplex_group: shared for half duplex or direction-qualified for full duplex

expert_placement.replicate_commit: destination allocation visible only at transfer forward completion
expert_placement.move_commit: destination allocation and source removal are atomic at transfer forward completion
expert_placement.pinned_source_move: hard-rejected in Phase6 v1; delayed invalidation is out of scope
expert_placement.visibility_insertion: must insert a previously absent destination location
